query: Optimize the DFP landing page for search — give me the on-page spec to make it rank.
expected_behavior: Produces a prescriptive change spec (recommended title/meta/H1, heading outline, content additions, internal links, schema, technical/CWV fixes), not a diagnosis
Builds on tron:seo-audit (current state) and tron:keyword-research (targets) rather than re-running them from scratch
Keeps every recommendation specific and implementable by a developer, with no vague 'improve content' hand-waves
Writes the spec to /tmp/seo/ and stays git-free, handing the implementation to a git user as a marketing-pages change
